label: GO step, choosing a1 after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2). 90% of mass is on steps where the agent chooses a1 (model_act/action == 1; choice-logit top bin has 6.9x lift), and 92% where the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew 0 at D1). Top activations are a1 choices right after a no-reward trial; it then decays over subsequent rewarded a1 trials (e.g. 1.00 -> 0.18 -> 0), a lingering trace of a recent omission. Never fires after in_rew=1 directly following a rewarded run, and rarely when choosing a2. Uses only the observed previous reward and the agent own upcoming choice (no future vars). Misses are mostly these decaying low-magnitude a1 GO steps 1-2 trials after a no-reward; false positives are a1-after-no-reward GOs where it stays silent (e.g. long rewarded histories, late-episode trials 90-99 where it almost never fires). Adding good==1 or value thresholds raised precision but cut recall; F1 ~0.63 dev, mass recall ~0.82.
